blocks.text:
After breakfast, transfer to the airport for your flight to Puerto Maldonado, where the Amazon leg of your trip begins.

On arrival, you’ll be met and taken to Inkaterra Hacienda Concepción, an eco-lodge in the rainforest. Part of the journey is by boat along the Tambopata River. Once you’ve checked in, enjoy a welcome drink and a short briefing on the area and the lodge’s environmental initiatives.

After dinner, head out with a guide on a night walk. As darkness falls, insects, amphibians and other nocturnal animals become active. You may see some of them in their natural habitat.

blocks.text:
After breakfast, you’ll head out on a guided nature walk through the lush forest. Your guide will introduce you to the rich flora and fauna of the rainforest, explaining the medicinal properties of plants and the behavior of native animals. You may encounter monkeys, exotic birds, and colorful butterflies.

 In the afternoon, embark on a canoe excursion along the river to explore the surrounding jungle waterways. This is a great opportunity to see wildlife like capybaras, caimans, and river birds. After returning to the lodge, enjoy a traditional Amazonian dinner, followed by a relaxed evening in the lodge's main area.
